[모멘텀 지표]

· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 76,460원 지지 확인 후 매수 고려 조건 명시
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (79,900 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (82,759/86,645/97,982 KRW): diagnosing short/mid-term trend below
· Position relative to SMA100/200 (105,335/101,456 KRW): assessing mid/long-term trend weakness
· 52-week position (26.4%) + current price range in historical low territory
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (30.6→35.8) + diagnosing entry into oversold zone + interpreting recovery attempt
· MACD histogram trajectory (-648.1190→-19.1982) + diagnosing improvement + weak signal for trend reversal
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 77,199 KRW) + interpreting band width at 21.80%
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (76,460 KRW) + basis (based on 20-day low)
· Swing resistance (89,580 KRW) + potential entry into neutral zone upon breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (attempting Higher Low) + recovery expectation
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.82x vs 5-day average) + confidence in movement contraction
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation zone) + specifying conditions for buying consideration after confirming support at 76,460 KRW
